title: •Theron Nett
caption: •Theron Nett (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. During your deploy phase, if piloting Red 10, may target one of your starships; ▼ a non-{set:theed} astromech or matching pilot aboard target.
lore: Experienced smuggler from Ord Mantell. Piloted Red 10 at the Battle of Yavin. Long-time wingman of Garven Dreis.

notes: Group: Everything else. Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2 / empty third box; deploy 2 / forfeit 4 (all as printed). Leading yellow LS pilot icon + '2.' → {pilot:2}. ▼ = deploy (the stub expands it as ▲ 'Take into hand…' — wrong). INLINE dark sphere with an orange starfighter before 'astromech' = Theed Palace expansion icon (rendered from the PDF at 2400 dpi; matches the Game Aid Feb 2024 Theed Palace icon) → {set:theed}; the stub reads it 'Immune-to-attrition icon' — wrong. Icon column: pilot (yellow LS helmet). Rebel (Rebel disc on the printed card). CREDITS in italics under the text box: 'Original concept by Brian Herold' left, 'Minnesota States 2005' right → credit_bottom. 'smuggler' looks plain (not bold) on the 350 px scan — left unmarked. Lore matches wiki. Copyright SE 1998 line read off the scan. Modern: VB1-L-theronnett-pre.gif (Virtual Block 1 reissue of this slip). Not used: V4-L-theronnett.gif = the different Virtual Set 4 Theron Nett (V).
